Me and my friends ground the seeds up in a coffee grinder and we put them in yogurt to eat them. It tasted fine when I ate them no bad taste at all just a little chunky. We left my friend's house to go to the park and 5 minutes after we left I had to have my boyfriend pull the car over so I could throw up. I felt disgusting after that. We got to the park and a little bit after we got there I threw up 3 more times. I started getting a headache and feeling really shitty. We went down to the lake and I felt fine for a little bit and all of a sudden my stomach started hurting really bad and I threw up again. I drank some water and felt ok after that but was still a little nauseous and scared. The rest of the night was ok until the next morning. I woke up feeling like I had a hangover and felt shitty all day. I would cry for no apparent reason. I didn't like it at all. Some of my friends enjoyed it but one other person ended up throwing up later that night and earlier in the night it didnt seem like he was enjoying it too much because he didn't know what was going on. That will be the last time I try morning glories.
